column1: # DF 53.16 Windows Steam native RTTI and virtual tables, read from the configured
# reference PE. RVAs use ImageBase 0x140000000. Caption slots +0x8 and +0x10
# are selected by the native renderer at 0x885553..0x885586. Slot +0x10 is used
# for categories 3, 6 and 7; 0x7e1230 is the inherited empty method.
# Native class-hierarchy descriptors identify 77 virtual tables whose base
# graph contains adventure_optionst; the directory includes that base table.
